part2.question: Describe someone who is older than you that you admire

segments.v: I want to talk about my aunt Hương. She is my mother's older sister. She is 58 years old. She was a primary school teacher but now she is retired. I knew her since I was a child because she lives near my house. She often took care of me when I was small. Now we often walk around West Lake on Sunday morning. We also exchange books. She started learning English three years ago, so I help her practise speaking. I also help her with her online shop at the weekend. I admire her because she is very active and she always learns new things. She is also very kind. She teaches poor children for free. I hope I will be like her when I am old.

fluency.band6: Facts in short sentences; one tense error.
fluency.band9: Who → change since retiring → how the speaker knows her → shared activities with humour → what the speaker admires (evidence) → personal motivation.

grammar.band6: Error: “I knew her since I was a child” (I've known her since…).
grammar.band9: “since + V-ing”, present perfect for achievements (she's learned English, started a business…), third-conditional idea (novels I would never have picked up myself), and a real conditional (if Aunt Hương can…, I've got no excuse).

analysis.keyDifference: Band 6 error: “I knew her since I was a child” should be present perfect (“I've known her since…”). Band 9 shows the relationship through shared activities, adds humour, and ends with a personal motivation drawn from her example.
